read: [00:00] Medi: Right. Okay. .. [1:04:26] CHAT Amal: enbasa6tellak / enbasa6etlak (all 921 turns)
coverage_note: 00:00-06:26 English chat about a song (Amal's Arabic shows as [foreign language], nothing of his to judge). 06:26-10:40 speaking warm-up (date, time, weather, clothes). 11:13-1:00:35 is a LISTENING drill: Amal says a sentence, he translates to English - his misreads are filed with mode=listening; his few spoken Arabic lines inside it are judged as speaking. 09:56-10:01 he hunted for the feminine of white (بياض? أبيض? بيضة) and landed on بيضة himself before her بيضة at 10:02 = self-fix (GR-22), not filed. 08:54 أبل امبارح was his own question about the form, she confirmed = not a slip. 08:40 'مش هوا، مش...' (not windy; sheet: it's windy | El-denia hawa) trailed off, no signal, not filed. 1:02:02 شوفك echoing her أشوفك = dropped glottal, pronunciation. Echoes (TR-19): 38:40 'ume mit as kamamara' = هما اتأسفوا ... كمان مرة؟; 38:48 'أُمه safulu' = هما اتأسفوا; 38:59 'By all eight' = بيتأسفوا (his present-tense reading, what Amal's لأ at 39:09 answers); 39:02 'Asafulu' = اتأسفوا; 27:34 'Min daya ik?' = مين ضايقك; 49:06 'My choose Aloo' = ما تزعلوا; 49:23 'Aloo' = -لوا; 50:30 'Aloo, uh, Bill' = له; 47:22 'Is that it's just too much fucked' = his repeat of زعجتو; 20:04 بيساع = his misrepeat of بيزعل; 51:24 Amal's عمسني = حمسني; 51:08 'تله' = له; 44:50 'zar-zarha, zar'a' = his attempt at زهقان. Chat lines lag 30-120 s and only confirm what she said.

rows.medi_said: تسعش ستة.
rows.why: Giving the date 19/9 he said ستة (six) for the month; Amal had already queried 'ستة؟' at 07:04, then recast تسعطاش تسعة and he repeated it at 07:15 - she heard ستة, so not the engine.

rows.medi_said: تسعش ستة.
rows.why: Nineteen came out as تسعش (and before that تسعة عشرين / تسعة عشر at 06:37-06:42, MSA shape) - the dialect form on her sheet is tese3ta3sh; Amal recast تسعطاش and he repeated it at 07:15.

rows.medi_said: بتغي-- بتغير كتير. No, بغير كتير. It's masculine.
rows.chat: el-jaw el-yoam t8ayyar kteer u shob mish m8ayyem
rows.why: He used the b- present (بتغير / بغير) for 'the weather changed'; Amal asked 'It changed?' and said 'تغير، no be' - past tense needed; he fixed it at 08:18 تغير كتير.
rows.english: the weather changed a lot today

rows.medi_said: شو يعني ريحته؟
rows.why: Didn't-know: he asked what ريحته (its smell) means (also 'خمارة?' at 09:15); Amal supplied ريحة and he said 'Oh, the smell'. Sheet: smell | ree7a | ريحة.

rows.medi_said: uh، كمي
rows.chat: el-yoam balbes 2amees rasmi abyad u ban6aloan azra2 8aame2 u kundara binniyye
rows.why: Describing dark-blue trousers he stalled on 'dark' (engine wrote كمي - possibly a weak attempt at غامق with غ/ق dropped, which would be S4 pronunciation); Amal supplied غامق and he repeated it. Sheet: dark (color) | 8aameq | غامق.

rows.medi_said: Uh, لسه ما... er ما تحمسي لسه
rows.why: Asked to say 'don't be excited yet' he said ما تحمسي (the make-excited form, also 'Matahammasi' at 38:13) instead of the get-excited form ما تتحمسي; Amal recast it and he said 'Oh, that's right. ما تتحمسي'.
rows.english: don't get excited yet (to a woman)

rows.medi_said: بزهق / بزهّق
rows.amal_said: زهقان. [تضحك] Of course it's that's it. It's بس زهق، زهق.
rows.why: Amal asked 'what's bored?' (the adjective); he gave the verbs بزهق / بزهّق, she said 'That's boring', he groped 'zar-zarha, zar'a?' and she supplied زهقان which he repeated at 45:12 - wrong form (verb for adjective) of a word he knows. Sheet: bored | Zahqaan | زهقان.

rows.medi_said: you took a photo or I, I take a photo? I had, had taken a photo?
rows.amal_said: Is it did you take a photo or did you get-- did you take a photo of yourself؟ Like, did you get photographed؟ Which one is it؟
rows.why: Listening: her اتصورت؟ (did you get photographed) he read as 'you took a photo'; after her prompt he got 'I got photographed. Or you got photographed' (12:10) and she said حلو.

rows.medi_said: you are tired of me.
rows.why: Listening: her تعبتني (you tired me) he read as 'you are tired of me' (تعبت مني); explicit 'No', he then gave 'you tired me' at 13:10.

rows.medi_said: Why did you smile to a male or why did she smile?
rows.right: why do you smile / why are you smiling
rows.why: Listening: her ليش بتضحك (present, b-) he read as past 'why did you smile'; she prompted 'did or do?' and he fixed to present.

rows.medi_said: Isn't this to inflict sadness? The past tense. ... Okay, I was sad.
rows.why: Listening: her زهقت (I got bored) he heard as زعلت (I got sad); she said 'زهقت مش زعلت' and he got 'I was bored' at 16:52.

rows.medi_said: They had fun or they enjoyed?
rows.amal_said: آآآ. Close بس that would be انبسطوا. انبسطوا
rows.why: Listening: she said 'close, but that would be انبسطوا' to his 'they', and he re-answered 'you guys enjoyed' (18:19) - she most likely said انبسطتوا (you pl.); the engine wrote both forms as انبسطوا and the chat (enbes6u) does not settle it.

rows.medi_said: What boring hap-- What happened boring?
rows.why: Listening: her اللي صار بيزعل he repeated as بيساع (20:04) and read as بيزهق 'boring'; she said 'No, بيزعل مش بيزهق' and he got 'what happened is sad' at 20:39.

rows.medi_said: He will not, he will not bore you.
rows.amal_said: Very close. أزهقك، not يزهقك. أزهقك.
rows.why: Listening: her ما راح أزهقك (I won't bore you) he read with 'he' (يزهقك); she said 'أزهقك not يزهقك' and gave 'I won't bore you' at 22:28.

rows.medi_said: Were you sad from what happened?
rows.amal_said: Very close. بس مش sad. انزعجتي.
rows.why: Listening: her انزعجتي من اللي صار he read as 'sad'; she said 'مش sad. انزعجتي' and he got 'annoyed' at 24:22.
rows.english: did you get annoyed by what happened?

rows.medi_said: so don't be tired of me.
rows.amal_said: That's ما تتعبي مني. ما تعبيني.
rows.why: Listening: her ما تعبيني (don't tire me, f.) he read as 'don't be tired of me' (ما تتعبي مني); she contrasted the two and he got 'Don't tire me' at 25:05.

rows.medi_said: She laughed at him.
rows.why: Listening: her ضحكت علي (she laughed at me) he read as 'at him' (عليه); she repeated علي and he fixed 'She laughed at me', admitting 'I'm never gonna get LA and LAE'.

rows.medi_said: Who was he mad with you-- at you? I don't... This doesn't make sense.
rows.wrong: who was he mad at you
rows.why: Listening: her مين ضايقك he first read as 'who was he mad at you'; she prompted 'What's ضايقك?' and he worked out ضايق = make upset, 'who made you upset' at 28:17.

rows.medi_said: I am happy... So بسطت is I was happy.
rows.why: Listening: her بسطته (I made him happy) he read as 'I am happy / I was happy' (انبسطت); she said 'No' (32:24) and 'I made', and he got 'I made him happy' at 32:46.

rows.medi_said: You guys...
rows.right: they (are happy when they see me)
rows.why: Listening: her بينبسطوا لما يشوفوني he started as 'You guys'; she repeated بينبسطوا and he gave 'they are happy when they see me' - a brief subject misread.
rows.english: they are happy when they see me

rows.medi_said: Yeah, they apologized. Present tense. Can I...
rows.right: اتأسفوا - past: they apologized to me
rows.why: Listening: her هما اتأسفوا مني he read as present (engine 'By all eight' = his بيتأسفوا at 38:59); she said 'لأ. اتأسفوا، not بيتأسفوا' and he agreed 'I said it with the first tense'.

rows.medi_said: I ruined the, the s- the trip. ... Oh, khirbat. Uh, she ruined the trip.
rows.amal_said: Are you sure؟ I ruined؟ ... No؟ That would be خربت. خربت.
rows.wrong: I ruined the trip / she ruined the trip
rows.why: Listening: her خربت السفرة / السفرة خربت (the trip got ruined, the get-X form) he read as 'I ruined' then 'she ruined' (the make-X خرّبت); she said 'Are you sure?' and 'No? That would be خربت', and he got 'the trip was ruined' at 40:14.

rows.medi_said: who was made happy by us?
rows.why: Listening: her مين انبسط معنا he read as the passive 'was made happy'; she repeated انبسط and he offered 'who enjoyed?' which she took (مهم).

rows.medi_said: who was made happy or who enjoyed from us?
rows.why: Listening: he heard معنا as منا ('from us' - 'I was saying mina', 42:47); she recast 'With us. معنا'.

rows.medi_said: Uh, are you excited to a girl?
rows.why: Listening: her تحمستِ (past, you f. got excited) he read as present 'are you excited'; she recast 'Did you get excited?' and he took it.

rows.medi_said: Why are you tired?
rows.right: why is it tiring (متعب, not تعبان)
rows.why: Listening: her ليش متعب (tiring) he read as 'tired' (تعبان); she repeated متعب and asked 'What's tired?' - he answered تعبان and got 'why is it tiring' at 44:18.

rows.medi_said: Not it as a don't be angry.
rows.why: Listening: her ما تتأسف he first read as 'don't be angry'; she repeated it and he got 'Oh, أسف. Don't apologize' at 47:00.

rows.medi_said: uh, you guys don't, uh, don't be annoyed.
rows.why: Listening: her ما تزعلوا منه he read as 'annoyed' (زعج); she prompted 'Annoyed?' and he fixed 'don't be sad from it or from him' (49:38-49:41).

rows.medi_said: She was happy. ... I enjoyed to it. No, Aloo, uh, Bill. Are you saying Bill?
rows.amal_said: No، انبسطت له. انبسطت له. Just the verb. I got happy له.
rows.wrong: She was happy / I enjoyed to it
rows.why: Listening: her انبسطت له (I was happy for him) he read as 'she was happy' then 'I enjoyed to it'; she said 'No' and 'For him', and he got 'I got happy for him' at 50:53.

rows.medi_said: You guys don't be annoyed.
rows.why: Listening: her ما تزعجوه (don't annoy him) he read as 'don't be annoyed' (تنزعجوا); she said 'تزعجوه not تنزعجوا' and he got 'don't be annoying to him' at 53:17.

rows.medi_said: They made us sad.
rows.why: Listening: her زعلوني (-ni, me) he read as 'us' (-na); she repeated زعلوني and he fixed 'They made me sad'.

rows.medi_said: So it made me happy...
rows.amal_said: صح، it made happy، بس is it past or present؟
rows.why: Listening: her بيبسطني إنه آجي (b- present) he read as past 'it made me happy'; she asked 'past or present?' and he fixed 'it makes me happy' at 56:22.

rows.medi_said: you came. Aji, you said, "It makes me happy he came."
rows.amal_said: آجي. I come. It makes me happy like coming makes me happy
rows.why: Listening: her آجي (I come, bare present after إنه) he read as 'you came' / 'he came'; she recast 'آجي. I come' and he got 'It's fun for me when I come' at 56:49.
rows.english: it makes me happy that I come

rows.medi_said: Did, uh, did you guys enjoy to me? Did you guys... I don't understand this one.
rows.amal_said: Great that you got the day part صح. They got-- they were happy for me. They got happy for me.
rows.wrong: did you guys enjoy to me
rows.why: Listening: her انبسطولي (they were happy for me) he read as 'did you guys enjoy to me'; after her repeat he said 'they enjoyed...' and she gave 'they were happy for me', which he took at 1:00:03.
